description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes related to IPv4 networking functions within the Zephyr project. It includes IGMP message structures, IPv4 header options, fragmentation handling, and creation/finalization functions for IPv4 packets.

methods.name: net_ipv4_create_full
methods.description: Creates an IPv4 packet with all settable fields specified, if supported by configuration.

methods.name: net_ipv4_create
methods.description: Creates an IPv4 packet with source and destination addresses.

methods.name: net_ipv4_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the IPv4 packet before sending, setting length and checksums.

methods.name: net_ipv4_parse_hdr_options
methods.description: Parses IPv4 header options and invokes a callback for each option.

methods.name: net_ipv4_frag_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all pending IPv4 fragments, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: net_ipv4_handle_fragment_hdr
methods.description: Handles IPv4 fragment headers, used in reassembly.

methods.name: net_ipv4_prepare_for_send
methods.description: Prepares a packet for sending, handling fragmentation if needed.

methods.name: net_ipv4_setup_fragment_buffers
methods.description: Sets up buffers for IPv4 fragmentation reassembly.
